refdiff-compare-mobile-toolbar.reason: The Toolbar comp draws no delta strip, so its 'warning' glyph has no counterpart; the app renders the strip as in the default layout. Measured: #delta-strip is 66px (y=45..111), which is the whole of the +60.6px offset on the Show row and the canvas offsets below it — those positions stay VISIBLE as the comp's gap, because a position rule would lapse on the next capture. Same ruling as the Minimal comp (Mato, 2026-08-29) and the 'everything stays as minimal' brief for this layout, 2026-09-02.

The Toolbar comp draws no delta strip, so its 'close' glyph has no counterpart; the app renders the strip as in the default layout. Measured: #delta-strip is 66px (y=45..111), which is the whole of the +60.6px offset on the Show row and the canvas offsets below it — those positions stay VISIBLE as the comp's gap, because a position rule would lapse on the next capture. Same ruling as the Minimal comp (Mato, 2026-08-29) and the 'everything stays as minimal' brief for this layout, 2026-09-02.
